item.title: Bulk Machine Tag Management in Defender for Endpoint
item.description: The Problem # Machine tags in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint are how you categorize devices for scoping, reporting, and dynamic device groups. “Offboarded,” “VIP,” “Kiosk,” “Critical” – whatever your taxonomy is, tags drive visibility and policy. The Defender portal lets you tag devices one at a time. The API lets you automate it. But writing a robust tagging script that handles edge cases – device not found, ambiguous name matches, tag already present, per-device tag overrides – takes more effort than most people invest. So they either tag manually or ship a fragile one-off script that breaks on the first edge case.
